title: Work IQ: real-time Teams meeting transcripts for apps and agents
summary: The briefing passes: Microsoft supports the transcript-access setting, its default and effective date, and consumption billing. Minor corrections should complete two control paths, simplify the Graph call, and qualify the spending-policy statement for direct Work IQ API integrations.

claims.claim: The briefing concerns roadmap item 570651.
claims.quote: "id": 570651, "title": "Work IQ: Real Time Transcripts"

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: General availability is targeted for November CY2026.
claims.quote: "targetDate": "November CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap preview target is September CY2026.
claims.quote: "previewDate": "September CY2026"

claims.claim: The roadmap lists General Availability and Preview as release phases.
claims.quote: "releasePhase": ["General Availability", "Preview"]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant).
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The roadmap lists Web as the platform.
claims.quote: "platforms": ["Web"]

claims.claim: The roadmap products are Microsoft Teams, Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365), and Work IQ.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Teams", "Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365)", "Work IQ"]

claims.claim: The roadmap modification timestamp is 2026-10-19T23:15:15.
The roadmap describes real-time Teams meeting transcript access for assistance and insights.
claims.quote: Enable applications and agents to access Microsoft Teams meeting transcripts in real time for assistance and insights.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Scope; Risk assessment
claims.claim: Work IQ lets apps and agents, including organisation-built ones, receive Teams meeting or call transcripts while in progress.
claims.quote: Work IQ lets agents and apps, including ones your organization builds, receive the transcript of a Teams meeting or call while it's in progress.

claims.claim: The separate Teams Work IQ access setting controls whether apps and agents receive real-time transcripts.
claims.quote: The Work IQ access setting controls whether they can. It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.claim: Work IQ access is independent of Microsoft Graph access.
claims.quote: It's independent of Microsoft Graph access, and it's off by default.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; What's changing; controls[0].note
claims.claim: Work IQ transcript access is off by default and administrators enable it, supporting admin-opt-in.
claims.quote:
Work IQ access is also off by default.
In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.claim: Enabling Work IQ transcript access does not start transcription.
claims.quote: Transcription is running. Work IQ doesn't start transcription.

claims.claim: AI must be allowed in the meeting, with Allow AI in all meetings on, for Work IQ transcripts to flow.
claims.quote:
| Allow AI in all meetings | Work IQ access | Result |
| Off | Off or On | No transcript is available. |
| On | On | Agents and apps can receive the real-time transcript. |

claims.claim: Transcription must be running before an app receives a Work IQ real-time transcript.
claims.quote:
An app receives a real-time transcript only when these conditions are also met:
Transcription is running. Work IQ doesn't start transcription.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user.
claims.quote: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user and has the permissions it needs in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; controls[1].governs; Governance controls
claims.claim: The app needs the appropriate Microsoft Entra permissions and consent to read transcripts.
claims.quote: The app acts on behalf of a signed-in user and has the permissions it needs in Microsoft Entra ID.

claims.claim: Work IQ must be enabled for the organisation of the user the app acts for.
claims.quote: Work IQ is enabled for that user's organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance; rationale: risk; changes
claims.claim: Learn gives 14 November 2026 as the Work IQ access setting's effective date.
claims.quote: Work IQ access takes effect on November 14, 2026.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Existing apps receiving real-time transcripts through Work IQ need Work IQ access enabled to keep working.
claims.quote: If apps in your organization already receive real-time transcripts through Work IQ, turn on Work IQ access before that date to keep them working.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Work IQ real-time transcripts include speaker names.
claims.quote: Real-time transcripts that apps receive through Work IQ include speaker names.

claims.claim: Include speaker attribution applies only to Microsoft Graph, not Work IQ real-time transcripts.
claims.quote: The Include speaker attribution setting applies only to Microsoft Graph.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Scope; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The meeting organiser's organisation determines transcript access rather than the app's tenant.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses the setting of the organization that organized the meeting, not the setting of the app's organization or of the user the app acts for.

claims.claim: Turning Work IQ access off does not stop transcripts apps are already receiving.
claims.quote: Turning off Work IQ access doesn't stop transcripts that apps are already receiving. They continue until the meeting or call ends. New requests are denied.

claims.claim: Changes to the Work IQ access setting are not immediate.
claims.quote: Changes aren't immediate. It can take some time before a change applies to new requests.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect Microsoft 365 Copilot in Teams.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect Facilitator.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.claim: The Work IQ access setting does not affect intelligent recap.
claims.quote: Microsoft AI experiences in Teams, such as Microsoft 365 Copilot, Facilitator, and intelligent recap, keep working as configured.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate transcript-specific licence is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real-time transcripts licensing; Work IQ real time transcripts license pricing rate Copilot Credits. Read Teams transcript API access, Work IQ enablement, API overview, and Microsoft's Work IQ GA licensing announcement; none names a transcript-specific licence.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate transcript-specific billing rate is documented as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Work IQ real-time transcripts price; Work IQ transcripts billing rate. Read Teams transcript API access, Work IQ API overview, usage-based billing overview, and Work IQ GA licensing announcement; general Work IQ rates exist, but no transcript-specific rate was found.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Work IQ uses consumption billing, supporting the consumption licensing model.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing.

claims.claim: Learn states a separate spending policy is not required for Work IQ.
claims.quote: Work IQ uses consumption billing. A separate spending policy isn't required for Work IQ.
claims.fix: Replace the spending-policy clause with: 'For Work IQ in Copilot Studio, Learn says a separate spending policy is not required. For direct Work IQ API integrations, Microsoft's migration guide instructs administrators to assign users to a spending policy that includes Work IQ API.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoft-365/copilot/extensibility/work-iq/mcp/migrate-retrieval-api#prepare-work-iq, which says 'assign the migration users to a spending policy that includes Work IQ API'.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Enabling Work IQ requires a usage-based billing plan set up in Copilot Studio.
claims.quote: A usage-based billing plan set up in Copilot Studio with an Azure subscription and resource group assigned.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The user must be assigned to the Work IQ billing plan.
claims.quote: The user assigned to the billing plan

claims.claim: Teams transcription must already be available for the meeting.
claims.quote: Transcription is running. Work IQ doesn't start transcription.

claims.claim: Work IQ agents may consume Copilot Credits, supporting variable cost.
claims.quote: Work IQ in Copilot Studio is powered by the Microsoft Copilot harness, which uses Copilot Credits for usage-based billing.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting settings > Transcript API access > WorkIQ access reaches the toggle.
claims.quote: In the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting settings. Under Transcript API access, turn the WorkIQ access toggle On.

claims.where: controls[0].api; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -Identity Global -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true enables Work IQ transcript access.
claims.quote:
When set to true, agents and apps can access real-time transcripts through Work IQ.
Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration -EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess $true -Identity Global

claims.claim: EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess requires the latest Teams PowerShell module.
claims.quote: This parameter requires the latest version of the Teams PowerShell module.

claims.claim: Microsoft Entra admin center > Entra ID > App registrations > app > API permissions reaches app permissions.
claims.quote:
Browse to Entra ID > App registrations, and then select your client application (not your web API).
Select API permissions, then Add a permission and select My APIs in the sidebar.
claims.fix: The path stops on the correct page but not at the consent control. For the tenant-registered apps this row describes, set ui.path and the rendered path to 'Entra ID > App registrations > All applications > app > Manage > API permissions > Grant admin consent', using the already-cited https://learn.microsoft.com/entra/identity/enterprise-apps/grant-admin-consent#grant-admin-consent-in-app-registrations-pane.

claims.claim: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants with clientId, consentType AllPrincipals, resourceId and scope grants delegated tenant-wide consent.
claims.quote:
POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants
Request body
{
 "clientId": "00001111-aaaa-2222-bbbb-3333cccc4444",
 "consentType": "AllPrincipals",
 "resourceId": "a0a0a0a0-bbbb-cccc-dddd-e1e1e1e1e1e1",
 "scope": "User.Read.All Group.Read.All"
}
claims.fix: Set api.call and the rendered call to 'POST https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/oauth2PermissionGrants'. Add to the note: 'The request body sets clientId, consentType (AllPrincipals), resourceId, and scope to grant delegated tenant-wide consent.'

claims.claim: App registrations provides the general Entra consent route for apps developed and registered in the tenant.
claims.quote: You can grant tenant-wide admin consent from App registrations in the Microsoft Entra admin center for applications your organization develops and registers directly in your Microsoft Entra tenant.

claims.claim: Programmatically granted permissions are not subject to review or confirmation.
claims.quote: Permissions granted programmatically are not subject to review or confirmation.

claims.claim: Programmatically granted permissions take effect immediately.
claims.quote: They take effect immediately.

claims.claim: Teams admin center > Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription reaches the transcription policy section.
claims.quote:
In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies.
Select an existing policy or create a new one.
Go to the Recording & transcription section
claims.fix: Set ui.path and the rendered path to 'Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Recording & transcription > Transcription'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-transcription-captions#meetings to sources and use it for ui.docs; it documents 'Toggle Transcription On or Off'. The cited Copilot page supplies the Recording & transcription section.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy> -AllowTranscription $true allows transcription through the named meeting policy.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity SalesMeetingPolicy -AllowTranscription $True
Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.

claims.where: controls[2].governs and scope; Governance guidance: Review transcription policies
claims.claim: Meeting policy transcription settings govern users' ability to transcribe meetings.
claims.quote: You can use the Recording & Transcription section in the Teams admin center or the -AllowTranscription parameter in the CsTeamsMeetingPolicy PowerShell cmdlet to manage your transcription policy.

claims.claim: The Teams Work IQ transcript toggle is tenant-wide, with no per-group scoping for that toggle.
claims.quote: Searched: WorkIQ access EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess group scope tenant policy. Read transcript API access and Set-CsTeamsMeetingConfiguration: Boolean EnableWorkIQTranscriptAccess; Identity accepts only Global. No group-scoped version of this toggle found.

claims.claim: For other provisioned enterprise apps, Entra ID > Enterprise apps > All applications > app > Security > Permissions reaches consent permissions.
claims.quote:
Browse to Entra ID > Enterprise apps > All applications.
Enter the name of the existing application in the search box, and then select the application from the search results.
Select Permissions under Security.
